environment.description: Actix-web service deployed on a bare EC2 instance behind an NLB (Network Load Balancer, Layer 4 only). PostgreSQL RDS with permissive security group. No API gateway or request filtering layer. JWT authentication middleware validates token signature using a local RSA public key file. Any authenticated user can call PATCH /api/v1/users/{id} with arbitrary fields.

config.database: RDS PostgreSQL 15, security group allows 5432 from app subnet
config.auth: JWT RS256 verified with local public key file /etc/app/jwt_pub.pem
config.network: VPC with public subnet, no WAF, no API Gateway
config.authorization: none - any valid JWT can update any user record
